propositions: Container restarts during in-flight code reviews cause the review-bot to time out the shutdown drain (45s) before the review completes (260-911s observed), resulting in a fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks automatic recovery.

Increasing DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS from 45 to 1200 (matching review timeout) and adjusting docker-compose stop_grace_period to 1320s allows in-flight reviews to complete before container shutdown without killing the review.

Retryable coverage-gap conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should cast no vote and defer via review_attempts ledger, leaving the change eligible for backfill reconciler re-drive instead of blocking recovery with a fail-closed vote.

After N (default 3) consecutive vote-less attempts on the same (change_id, revision), escalate to a fail-closed -1 vote with 'retries exhausted' note and emit VOTER_ERROR metric to surface the persistent failure.

The review_attempts table (keyed by change_id, revision) tracks retryable attempt counts separately from the voted ledger; reset_attempts deletes the row to allow manual re-trigger without leaving stale counters.
Terminal outcomes (finding, indeterminate, gate-disabled) and PASS verdicts continue to cast votes (+1 or -1); only retryable infrastructure/transient errors defer vote-less to the reconciler.
